title: quercus × coutinhoi subsp. duriensis
intro: Quercus × coutinhoi subsp. duriensis, commonly known as the hybrid of the cork oak (Quercus suber) and the holm oak (Quercus ilex), is a unique plant species. This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Quercus × coutinhoi subsp. duriensis include its ability to act as an anti-arthritic, anti-asthmatic, and anti-ulcer agent, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including quercetin and ursolic acid, have been shown to possess antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
